messages:
katie_pm: Heads up — Orchard (Private) wants the model/infra change deployed tonight during the 00:00–02:00 UTC quiet window. Asking for final ops + SRE sign-off. Changes: model -> v2.3.1-quant, reserve 8 GPUs, enable prefix caching for active tenants.

deploybot: [dry-run] started for orchard-prod at 2026-03-21T22:15Z. steps: validate-config -> terraform-plan -> smoke-run. ETA ~8m.

jordan_se: quick note — their KMS rotation is scheduled 23:30 UTC. If we overlap, we lose access to customer secrets for ~3m while keys swap. We should avoid that collision.

anne_ops: if we move to 01:00 UTC we avoid KMS rotation and US peak. Cost estimate for extra reserved hour ~+$260 for the slice. OK with finance?

lucy_cs: Orchard asked for minimal visible impact — prefer the later window if ops approves. They're on standby and will hold traffic shift for 30m if anything flakey shows.

sophie_sre: list of SLO checks I need before greenlight:
- p50/p95 token latency baseline compare (today vs canary)
- error-rate spike threshold at +0.5%
- KV-cache hitrate sanity check after deploy

mike_releaselead: deploy plan (condensed):
```
1) Reserve capacity: allocate 8xA10 -> warm, healthcheck all agents
2) Deploy model v2.3.1-quant to staging slice
3) Run smoke prompts + automated evals (10k tokens)
4) Canary 5% traffic for 15m -> monitor latency/errors
5) If stable, shift 50% then 100% over 30m increments
6) If regressions, immediate fallback to v2.2.9-q8 and drain new nodes
```

katie_pm: Can we avoid the KMS collision by nudging to 01:10 UTC? That still fits Orchard's quiet window. Ops, can you confirm capacity + cost?

anne_ops: 01:10 works. I'll prime the nodes at 00:50 and keep them idle until the deploy. Cost delta accepted.

deploybot: dry-run finished -> terraform-plan OK, smoke-run FAILED on 1 check: `kv-cache init timeout` on node g-3. Logs: https://deploy.logs/r/5612349876/1 :eyes:

jordan_se: reproducing locally now. Likely caused by the init ordering in the new image. Patch idea: increase init timeout from 12s -> 30s for the cache service. Small change; doesn't affect model binary.

sophie_sre: Until dry-run passes, I can't sign off on canary. Also need a regression test harness run with the actual Orchard prompt set. Lucy, can you attach the prompt set?

lucy_cs: attached prompt_set_orchard_v1.json to the ticket — linking: https://tickets/repo/ORCH-214

mike_releaselead: I'll apply the timeout bump and rerun the dry-run in 10m. If it passes, we proceed with the 01:10 start. If fails again, fallback plan is to delay to tomorrow and notify Orchard.

deploybot: [dry-run retry] started at 2026-03-21T22:40Z.

deploybot: [dry-run retry] success — all checks OK. Smoke prompts ran against `prompt_set_orchard_v1.json` (0 failures). Artifacts: /artifacts/5612349876/dryrun-2

sophie_sre: Reviewed artifacts. Latency delta vs baseline: p50 +3ms, p95 +18ms (within our +25ms threshold). Error rate unchanged. KV-cache hitrate 92% after warm. :thumbsup:

anne_ops: Capacity primed. Reserved pool up at 00:50 UTC. I'll start the health probes at 01:00.

katie_pm: Final approvals? I need explicit thumbs from SRE + Release.

mike_releaselead: +1 from release. I will be on the infra channel and ready to execute rollback script if needed.

sophie_sre: +1 from SRE. Monitoring hooks in place (alert if p95 > baseline + 25ms or error-rate +0.5%).

lucy_cs: Customer liaison confirmed standby and comms ready.

katie_pm: OK launching at 01:10 UTC. Steps: start -> canary 5% 15m -> evaluate -> continue. If we hit alert, rollback immediately to v2.2.9-q8.

deploybot: Deploy started at 2026-03-21T01:10:00Z for orchard-prod (orchestrator run id rb-5612349876). Canary traffic 5% applied.

deploybot: Canary metrics update (15m): p95 +12ms, errors +0.02%, CPU steady. No alerts.

katie_pm: Moving to 50% over next 20m.

deploybot: Traffic shifted to 50% at 2026-03-21T01:35:00Z. Monitoring...

sophie_sre: Live checks look clean. One minor worker restart observed — restarted, rejoined, KV-cache warmed within ~45s. No client-facing errors.

deploybot: Traffic 100% at 2026-03-21T02:05:00Z. Post-deploy smoke evals running.

deploybot: Post-deploy evals passed. All green. Release note auto-generated: "orchard: upgraded model to v2.3.1-quant; enabled prefix caching; reserved 8 GPUs. No service impact observed." Link: https://releases/redwood/5612349876

katie_pm: Thanks team — closing this thread. I'll publish the release note and notify Orchard that we've completed the rollout and left rollback window open for 24h.

lucy_cs: Orchard CS confirms: "No issues seen, thanks" :tada:

mike_releaselead: Leaving rollback hooks up for 24h. If anything shows up, we can revert to v2.2.9-q8 with `rb rollback --target v2.2.9-q8 --run-id rb-5612349876`.

sophie_sre: I'll keep an eye on the dashboards through the night. Ping me if anything noisy shows.

katie_pm: Great job. :party_parrot:
